reason: It's a brand new service and I've never seen anyone on TikTok unbox something from them, so I'm not sending money up front to people I don't know. If a friend tries it first and it arrives fine, then maybe.
objection: If the item comes fake, the wrong size or the colour isn't like the photo, will they really refund me, or will they say it's 'as ordered' and I lose my money because change-of-mind returns aren't allowed?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing real unboxing videos from Baghdad girls or a friend I trust ordering from them and getting her item right.
